description: Build a minimal valid ApexStock options object for a financial / stock chart. Generates a placeholder OHLCV candle series when `data` is omitted, so the result renders as-is. Note: ApexStock does not bundle ApexCharts. The host provides the constructor per instance (`new ApexStock(el, options, { ApexCharts })`), once app-wide (`ApexStock.setApexCharts(ApexCharts)`), or as the `window.ApexCharts` global. That is a host-page concern, not part of this options object.

data.description: OHLC candles for series[0].data. Each point: { x, y: [open, high, low, close], v? }. Omit for a placeholder series.

indicators.description: Indicators to enable: a list of keys (e.g. ["moving average", "rsi"]) or a keyed config map (e.g. { "bollinger bands": { period: 20, stdDev: 2 } }). Overlays and oscillators both stack; each oscillator gets its own pane.

name: apexstock_generate_config
title: Generate ApexStock config
